thread:
Maya (ML Eng): quick heads-up: Boreal-9p int8 canary shows a degradation on the long-legal summarization slice. Need cost-vs-quality triage for GTN.

Omar (Eval): short numbers: N=750; fp16 ROUGE-L=0.602, int8 ROUGE-L=0.564 (delta -0.038 ~6.3% rel). latency med -29%, p95 -31%. hallucination rate up ~1.3x on the slice.

Priya (Infra): canary logs: seq observed up to 1536, quant=per-channel int8, layernorm quantized=true. No OOMs but some requests hit seq>1024 path.

Maya (ML Eng): hypotheses: (a) layernorm quant drift on long contexts, (b) kv-cache rounding accumulation, (c) attention scaling sensitivity in per-channel int8.

Omar (Eval): cost snapshot: fp16 unit ~ $0.0115 /1k tokens, int8 ~ $0.0043 /1k => ~62% token-cost saving. For 50M tokens/mo slice full-int8 saves ~ $360k/mo; hybrid protecting 20% of slice reduces savings to ~ $288k/mo.

Ethan (Product): that slice is revenue-dense (enterprise summarization). Need options: full int8 (max save, risk), mixed-lnorm (keep layernorm fp16), seq-gated routing (long->fp16). Which experiment first?

Maya (ML Eng): plan: 1) quick mixed-lnorm build (layernorm fp16) run on canary traffic for 48h, 2) seq-gate route seq>768 to fp16 for 72h, 3) per-tensor vs per-channel int8 compare in eval harness.

Priya (Infra): I'll push seq-gate flag and tag a mixed-lnorm model build boreal9p-int8-mxn1. Will also collect kernel selection traces for any failing request ids.

Omar (Eval): I'll add a slice dashboard card showing ROUGE, hallucination-rate, token-divergence and run 150 human spot-checks for failures.

Maya (ML Eng): quick triage result: local mixed-lnorm recovered ~0.02 ROUGE-L of the gap (int8+mixed-lnorm -> 0.584). Encouraging but not full recovery.

Ethan (Product): good. Prepare a short GTN brief with two options and estimated savings + risk metric. Prioritize protecting top 10 customers if needed.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: boreal9p-int8-seqgate starting in 15m (ticket #2244).

Maya (ML Eng): decision: run mixed-lnorm + seq-gate canary; if mixed-lnorm recovers >=80% of gap we prefer hybrid rollout (int8 default + seq-based fp16 for long docs). Will update in 72h.
